name: Ascentia
summary: Analytics platform with prognostic health monitoring, an AOG management board and an NLP-based Repeaters app that clusters free-text defects.
paragraphs: Analytics platform with prognostic health monitoring, an AOG management board and an NLP-based Repeaters app that clusters free-text defects.
whyItMatters: Lets airline engineers build their own predictive alerts with low-code tools, then measure them across the fleet.
